steps.content: In the uninhabited part of WhiteSands on the border of DisCity, the envoys are regrouping after evading all of their pursuers. From this position, they happen to be able to get a full view of DisCity.
Under the calamity, the most prosperous city is now enduring new trials.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: Despite the despicable minority, most people there are innocent. They shouldn't have to suffer this kind of catastrophe... No one should.
But there's nothing more they can do now.
This is the third time they've witnessed the fall of a city. Perhaps they should have gotten used to these tragedies, to their own powerlessness and resignation, and to this grievance.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: The Almighty Bow is gone, and Xu has become that thing we saw... Since the people of DisCity don't believe in myths, the myths have no power to save them.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: We have no more reason to stay. It's time to go.
In the distance, they can see the densely packed army and armor gathering in the DisSea. This time, Paradeisos is utilizing firepower several times stronger than in the Sun Shot operation.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...Let's hear from the seer. Yanyan, shall we go?
She looks at the girl sitting with her arms around her knees gazing into the distance, but she doesn't look back at Du Ruo.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...You're a liar, Du Ruo.
Yanyan sits alone. Du Ruo has already used her ability to reduce her fever, but the girl still looks sullen with red eyes.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You knew all along that the Sun Shot would fail. If you had told us earlier...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I'm sorry. I'll admit I tell lies pretty often, but when it comes to the truth about the myth and whether the Sun Shot is real... No one could be sure until the very last moment.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: If it weren't for your continuous efforts, I wouldn't have been able to weed out the obstruction and prove my guess.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Sorry it took me so long to decode everything. You see, I don't know all the things in the world after all. Will you forgive me?
She squats down, takes Yanyan's hand, and pats her head.
The girl's eyes turn red.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Will DisCity really be ruined by the Sun Crow? Just like Sunset Town... and many other cities in Eastia?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Can't we do something more for them? Must we go now?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Even if this place isn't our homeland, even if many here mock you, you still want to help them?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I do! This place is also the home of those reliable big guys in white armor, those helpful folks at the Drifter Camp, the old man at the Rust who told me about the future of the amusement park, and Chief who accompanied me everywhere.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Not just them, there are so many people here striving to live, just like in Sunset Town and Eastia.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: We've suffered that kind of torment ourselves, that's why we want to stop the Sun Crow, to prevent it from harming others! We came all this way here for this, didn't we?
Slowly, the girl stops crying, and her voice becomes more determined.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You said that the seer of the Sun Shot must have a strong faith to lead more people and wield greater power. Then...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I believe DisCity will not be burned down. There must be new sacred signs... No, there must still be something I can do!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I'm a full-fledged seer now. I will never run away from catastrophe, from those who need me!
Having heard Yanyan's speech, Du Ruo falls silent for a moment, then turns to look at the other envoys.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh, what do we do, Ambassador? Our little great seer here doesn't want to give up just yet. And I must say she's got a point.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: ...You've been the one reluctant to give up this whole time, scholar.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Haha, after all, we've all experienced that kind of desperate situation seven years ago. As long as there's a glimmer of hope, we'll cling to it and never let go.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: ...I don't get you.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: One moment you call the myth a placebo and a lie. The next, you're suddenly its believer and even hope for the elusive miracles. You knew the chance of success was slim, yet you still joined the delegation to come here.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: ...You used to be an open book, but now you're a mystery.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I don't deny the power of the myth, and I haven't really changed.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Besides, you and I may have different views, but we've been fighting side by side for seven years now. What's a small disagreement to us?
The two old friends exchange a smile.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: ...You're right. Let's get started then. We have only ourselves to blame for always putting our faith in you.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The Sun Crow has invaded Yanyan's mind before, which means I can now catch its tail through channeling!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It won't be easy, but I'll conduct the sorcery and help everyone catch it again!
Yanyan retreats to Du Ruo's side and sits cross-legged, activating her ability.
The spell she's chanting tentatively is none other than the one that bolsters the Sun Shot sorcery.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: ...It was a long journey to come here. Of course, we can't give up so easily.
Du Ruo smiles and knows they need no more persuasion. She waves the incense burner, infusing powerful energy into the sorcery, connecting it to the Sun Crow.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Yes... No one could be sure until the very last moment.
The sorcery works. Paradeisos' armor has also spotted the Sun Crow's weakness, aiming and firing in unison.
The battle resumes...
